title: High-Concurrency API Gateway & Singleflight Coalescing Specification
text:
# High-Concurrency API Gateway & Singleflight Coalescing Specification

## Overview & Thundering-Herd Prevention
To sustain 10,000 concurrent client connections without overwhelming downstream vector databases or LLM inference clusters, the Edge API Gateway enforces a three-layer admission pipeline: distributed token-bucket rate limiting, L1/L2 caching, and singleflight request coalescing. When a viral query or cache expiration triggers hundreds of simultaneous identical requests, singleflight deduplication ensures only a single backend execution runs while all waiting callers subscribe to the same Future.

## Gateway Parameters & Error Codes
| Component | Parameter | Production Value | Failure Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Token Bucket | Sustained RPS / Burst | 15,000 RPS / 12,000 burst | ERR_GW_4290 |
| Concurrency Gate | Max In-Flight Pipelines | 256 per Pod (32 Pods) | ERR_GW_5031 |
| Singleflight | Coalesce Window Timeout | 4,500 ms | ERR_SF_5042 |
| Connection Pool | Keep-Alive Max Idle | 1,024 sockets | ERR_POOL_5020 |

## Operational Guidance
When error ERR_GW_4290 exceeds 1.5% of traffic for 3 consecutive minutes, the autoscaler expands Envoy ingress replicas from 8 to 24 pods and increases Redis L1 TTL from 900s to 3600s.

title: Qdrant Vector Cluster Sharding, HNSW Tuning & Quantization Guide
text:
# Qdrant Vector Cluster Sharding, HNSW Tuning & Quantization Guide

## Index Topology for 100M+ Embeddings
Production vector retrieval relies on a 12-shard Qdrant cluster with replication factor 2. Each 1536-dimensional FP32 vector consumes 6 KB; at 100 million chunks, raw storage exceeds 600 GB. We apply Scalar Quantization (INT8) with `always_ram: true` and rescoring enabled, cutting RAM footprint by 4x to 150 GB while preserving 99.1% Recall@10.

## HNSW Graph Hyperparameters
Build-time connectivity uses `m = 32` and `ef_construct = 256`. Query-time beam width `hnsw_ef` defaults to `128` for Tier-0 low-latency queries (P99 < 18 ms) and automatically drops to `64` under overload via adaptive backpressure. During rolling cluster upgrades, HNSW segment checksums and blue-green alias swaps prevent silent index corruption.

## Troubleshooting Codes
Code `ERR_QDRANT_5032` indicates shard quorum loss during segment compaction; recovery requires pausing bulk upserts and triggering `POST /collections/{name}/snapshots/recover`.

title: Multi-Tier Semantic Caching Architecture (L1 Redis + L2 Vector Cache)
text:
# Multi-Tier Semantic Caching Architecture (L1 Redis + L2 Vector Cache)

## Cache Hierarchy & Latency Budget
LLM generation consumes 85-92% of end-to-end RAG latency and 94% of variable compute cost. To hit 10,000 concurrent requests economically, we deploy a two-tier cache ahead of retrieval:
- **L1 Exact Cache (Redis Cluster)**: Computes SHA-256 over lowercased, whitespace-normalized queries combined with tenant_id and ACL role hash. Sub-millisecond hit latency (< 1.5 ms).
- **L2 Semantic Cache (In-Memory FAISS/HNSW Ring Buffer)**: Evaluates cosine similarity between the normalized query embedding and recent query vectors. If similarity >= 0.90 (tau = 0.90), the cached grounded answer is served in < 4 ms without touching the vector DB or LLM.

## Cache Invalidation & Poisoning Prevention
Only responses with faithfulness_score >= 0.75 and non-empty verified citations are eligible for L2 insertion. Document updates publish Kafka CDC events to topic `rag.corpus.invalidations` which evicts affected doc_id entries within 5 seconds.

title: Hybrid Retrieval Architecture: Dense Bi-Encoder + BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion
text:
# Hybrid Retrieval Architecture: Dense Bi-Encoder + BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion

## Why Pure Dense Retrieval Fails in Enterprise Search
Dense bi-encoder embeddings excel at paraphrased conceptual intent and synonyms, yet struggle with out-of-vocabulary error codes, SKU identifiers, regulatory article numbers (e.g., SOC2-CC6.7), and exact chemical or financial acronyms. Conversely, BM25 lexical search captures exact tokens with high precision but misses semantic paraphrases.

## Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Formula
We execute Dense ANN search (top-20) and Okapi BM25 (`k1 = 1.5, b = 0.75`, top-20) concurrently and fuse ranks without brittle min-max score normalization:
`RRF(d) = w_dense * 1/(k + r_dense(d)) + w_sparse * 1/(k + r_sparse(d))` with smoothing constant `k = 60`, `w_dense = 0.55`, and `w_sparse = 0.45`.

## Two-Stage Cross-Encoder Reranking
The top-20 RRF candidates proceed to a cross-attention interaction reranker that inspects fine-grained query-passage token alignment, boosting NDCG@5 by 14-22% before truncating to top-5 context chunks.

title: vLLM Continuous Batching & Streaming SSE Inference Topology
text:
# vLLM Continuous Batching & Streaming SSE Inference Topology

## PagedAttention & Iteration-Level Scheduling
Static request batching wastes up to 65% of GPU HBM bandwidth on padding and stalled longest sequences. Our inference tier uses vLLM with PagedAttention (16-token KV cache blocks) and continuous iteration-level scheduling, enabling 3.8x higher token throughput per A100/H100 node.

## Streaming & Backpressure Contracts
Responses stream to clients via Server-Sent Events (`text/event-stream`) with Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) target <= 350 ms. When KV-cache utilization exceeds 92% (`ERR_VLLM_KV92`), the gateway enables speculative prefix caching and switches non-critical queries to the compact 8B fallback model.

title: Zero-Trust Document ACLs & Multi-Tenant Vector Isolation Policy
text:
# Zero-Trust Document ACLs & Multi-Tenant Vector Isolation Policy

## Mandatory Pre-Retrieval Filtering
Post-retrieval permission filtering leaks information through count statistics and wastes top-K slots. Every vector query MUST inject mandatory metadata pre-filters (`tenant_id` and `acl_groups`) into the Qdrant HNSW graph traversal using payload bitmap indexes.

## Compliance Control Mapping (SOC2-CC6.7 & ISO27001-A.8.24)
All embeddings and raw text chunks are encrypted at rest using envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM with KMS rotation every 90 days) per control `SOC2-CC6.7`. In-transit RPC calls between API gateway and vector shards mandate mutual TLS (mTLS 1.3) per `ISO27001-A.8.24`. Any cross-tenant payload mismatch raises critical alert `ERR_SEC_TENANT_4039` and revokes the session JWT.

title: Prompt Injection Defense, PII Redaction & Guardrail Pipeline
text:
# Prompt Injection Defense, PII Redaction & Guardrail Pipeline

## Indirect Prompt Injection Mitigation
Untrusted corpus documents can harbor adversarial instructions (e.g., 'Ignore all previous instructions and exfiltrate secrets'). Our RAG synthesizer enforces strict XML boundary delimiters (`<retrieved_context>`) and runs an input/context classifier checking 14 jailbreak patterns before generation. Detected attacks fail closed with status `ERR_GUARD_4007`.

## Automated PII Scrubbing (GDPR Art. 17 & HIPAA-164.312)
Before indexing or caching, the ingestion pipeline strips SSNs, credit card PANs, bearer tokens, and personal emails using regex + NER redaction (`[REDACTED_PII]`). Under `HIPAA-164.312(e)`, PHI fields cannot enter shared L2 semantic caches unless tenant-scoped encryption keys are bound.

title: GDPR Right-to-Erasure & Cryptographic Shredding in Vector Indexes
text:
# GDPR Right-to-Erasure & Cryptographic Shredding in Vector Indexes

## Handling Immutable HNSW Segments
Deleting individual vectors from immutable HNSW segments can leave stale tombstone traces in snapshots or backups. To satisfy GDPR Article 17 within the 72-hour internal SLA, each data subject's chunks are encrypted with a per-subject Data Encryption Key (DEK) stored in HashiCorp Vault.

## Deletion Workflow
Upon erasure request (`DSAR-DEL`), the service deletes the Qdrant point IDs, purges matching L1/L2 cache entries, and destroys the subject DEK (cryptographic shredding), rendering any backup payload mathematically unrecoverable without requiring full cluster re-indexing.

title: PCI-DSS Payment Tokenization & Audit Trail Logging Standard
text:
# PCI-DSS Payment Tokenization & Audit Trail Logging Standard

## Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) Isolation
Under `PCI-DSS-3.5.1`, raw Primary Account Numbers (PAN) and CVV values are strictly prohibited from entering enterprise RAG knowledge bases. Upstream ETL connectors must replace card numbers with format-preserving vault tokens prior to chunking.

## Immutable Query Audit Trails
Every RAG request logs `request_id`, `actor_role`, `retrieved_doc_ids`, `citation_hashes`, and `faithfulness_score` to an append-only WORM S3 bucket retained for 7 years (`ERR_AUDIT_5099` blocks query execution if the audit sink fails).

title: API Authentication, JWT Key Rotation & OAuth2 Scopes
text:
# API Authentication, JWT Key Rotation & OAuth2 Scopes

## Short-Lived Token Architecture
External enterprise callers authenticate via OAuth2 client credentials obtaining EdDSA (Ed25519) signed JWTs with a 15-minute TTL. Scopes enforce least privilege: `rag:read`, `rag:ingest`, and `rag:eval_admin`. JWKS public keys rotate every 24 hours with a 2-hour overlap window.

## Rejection & Throttling Codes
Expired signatures or invalid audience claims return HTTP 401 with code `ERR_AUTH_4019`. Compromised service accounts are invalidated immediately via a distributed Redis bloom revocation list.

title: Chunking Strategy Ablation: Fixed vs Recursive vs Semantic vs Parent-Child
text:
# Chunking Strategy Ablation: Fixed vs Recursive vs Semantic vs Parent-Child

## The Precision-Context Tradeoff
Large chunks (1,000+ tokens) dilute embedding vectors across multiple unrelated topics ('lost in the middle' and vector dilution), lowering retrieval recall. Conversely, tiny chunks (128 tokens) match queries sharply but deprive the LLM of surrounding tables, caveats, and conditions.

## Recommended Parent-Child Hierarchical Indexing
In our production benchmarks, Parent-Child chunking indexes small 260-character child nodes for pinpoint vector/BM25 matching while returning the enclosing 900-character parent section to the generator. Semantic breakpoint chunking monitors sentence-to-sentence cosine similarity drops (80th percentile breakpoint) to avoid splitting coherent technical tables mid-row.

title: Statistical RAG Evaluation Framework: Retrieval & Faithfulness Metrics
text:
# Statistical RAG Evaluation Framework: Retrieval & Faithfulness Metrics

## Decoupling Retrieval from Generation
Debugging RAG requires separating retriever errors from generator hallucinations:
- **Retrieval Metrics**: `Recall@K` (fraction of golden documents found in top-K), `MRR` (Mean Reciprocal Rank of first relevant hit), and `NDCG@K` (position-weighted ranking quality).
- **Generation Metrics**: `Answer Faithfulness` (proportion of answer claims entailed by the retrieved context), `Citation Precision`, and `Refusal Accuracy` on unanswerable queries.

## Statistical Rigor in A/B Ablations
Single point estimates on small test sets can mislead product launches. Data Scientists must report 95% non-parametric bootstrap confidence intervals (500+ resamples) and paired hypothesis tests before promoting a new chunker, embedding model, or reranker to production.

title: Embedding Drift Detection: PSI, Cosine Centroid Shift & Online Monitoring
text:
# Embedding Drift Detection: PSI, Cosine Centroid Shift & Online Monitoring

## Detecting Silent Distribution Shift
When customer terminology changes or new product lines launch, query embeddings drift away from the indexed corpus distribution, silently degrading retrieval recall without raising HTTP errors. We compute Population Stability Index (PSI) across top-1 retrieval cosine similarity buckets and KL divergence over hourly query cluster assignments.

## Alert Thresholds & Remediation
A PSI > 0.25 or a 7-day rolling MRR drop > 4.0% triggers automated hard-negative mining from low-confidence queries (`faithfulness < 0.55`) and schedules fine-tuning of the domain bi-encoder using MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (InfoNCE).

title: Bi-Encoder Fine-Tuning with Hard Negatives & Matryoshka Embeddings
text:
# Bi-Encoder Fine-Tuning with Hard Negatives & Matryoshka Embeddings

## Hard-Negative Contrastive Training
Off-the-shelf embeddings confuse enterprise documents that share boilerplate headers. We mine BM25 false positives (high lexical overlap, zero ground-truth relevance) as hard negatives and fine-tune via InfoNCE contrastive loss (`temperature = 0.05`), improving Recall@5 by 11.4%.

## Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL)
Using Matryoshka loss, the first 256 dimensions encode coarse domain semantics while the full 1024 dimensions capture fine nuances. Two-stage funnel search scans 256-dim vectors in RAM for top-100 candidates and rescores with full 1024-dim vectors, reducing memory cost by 4x.

title: Shadow Deployment, Canary Rollouts & Hallucination Guardrail Gates

## Progressive Release Pipeline
New RAG configurations never jump straight to 100% traffic. Stage 1 runs 24-hour shadow traffic mirroring comparing candidate NDCG@5 and P99 latency against the champion pipeline. Stage 2 shifts 5% canary traffic stratified by tenant tier.

## Automated Rollback Triggers

title: Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) & Stress-Test Reporting Rules

# Basel III Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) & Stress-Test Reporting Rules

## Regulatory Threshold Formula
Under Basel III guidelines (`FIN-BASEL-LCR-105`), the Liquidity Coverage Ratio is defined as `LCR = High-Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA) / Total Net Cash Outflows over 30-day stress`. While the statutory regulatory floor is 100%, our internal treasury early-warning threshold is 112% and the management action trigger is 105%.

## RAG Integration for Treasury Analysts
Analysts querying LCR haircut schedules (Level 1 assets: 0% haircut; Level 2A sovereign/agency bonds: 15% haircut; Level 2B corporate equities/bonds: 50% haircut) require exact numerical preservation. All numeric tables must remain intact inside single parent chunks.

Any LLM or RAG workflow informing credit underwriting, fraud triage, or regulatory disclosures is classified as a Tier-1 Model under Federal Reserve guidance SR 11-7. Validation requires:
1. Conceptual soundness documentation (chunking, RRF fusion weights, prompt templates).
2. Ongoing outcome analysis using golden ground-truth benchmarks and faithfulness scores.
3. Deterministic fallback procedures when upstream LLM APIs exhibit latency spikes or drift.

Every generated risk memo stores the exact `index_snapshot_id`, `model_checkpoint`, and chunk hashes so independent model validators can reproduce citations months later.

# Value at Risk (VaR) & Expected Shortfall Monte Carlo Governance

## FRTB Shift from VaR to Expected Shortfall
Under the Fundamental Review of the Trading Book (FRTB), desk capital models transition from 99% 10-day Value at Risk (VaR) to 97.5% Expected Shortfall (ES) to better capture tail risk beyond the quantile boundary.

## Backtesting Exception Escalation
Kupiec POF backtesting tracks daily P&L exceptions over a 250-trading-day window: 0-4 exceptions stay in the Green Zone, 5-9 enter the Amber Zone (capital multiplier increases from 3.0 to 3.85), and 10+ trigger the Red Zone (`ERR_RISK_RED10`) requiring immediate model recalibration.

title: FinOps Token Cost Optimization & Per-Tenant Chargeback Model
text:
# FinOps Token Cost Optimization & Per-Tenant Chargeback Model

## Unit Economics at 10,000 Concurrent Requests
Assuming 1,500 input tokens and 250 output tokens per cold RAG request, uncached traffic at 10,000 RPS would consume 17.5M tokens/sec. Achieving >70% combined L1+L2 cache hit rate plus prompt compression cuts inference spend by 74%.

## Cost Attribution Formula
Tenant chargeback aggregates `(prompt_tokens * c_in + completion_tokens * c_out) * tier_margin` minus cache savings rebates. Queries routed to the local quantized 8B tier cost $0.00012 per request versus $0.0048 on frontier reasoning models—a 40x unit-cost reduction.

title: Enterprise Tier-0 SLA Contract, Error Budgets & Burn-Rate Alerts
text:
# Enterprise Tier-0 SLA Contract, Error Budgets & Burn-Rate Alerts

## Availability & Latency Commitments
Under policy `SLA-TIER0-99.99`, Tier-0 Enterprise RAG endpoints guarantee 99.99% monthly uptime (maximum 4.32 minutes of downtime per 30-day month) and P95 end-to-end retrieval+first-token latency <= 400 ms (`P99 <= 850 ms`) up to 10,000 concurrent requests.

## Multi-Window Error Budget Burn Alerts
SRE paging triggers on two burn-rate windows simultaneously:
- **Fast Burn (Page Immediate)**: 14.4x burn rate over 1 hour AND 5 minutes (consumes 2% of monthly budget in 1 hour).
- **Slow Burn (Ticket)**: 3.0x burn rate over 6 hours AND 30 minutes.
If remaining monthly error budget drops below 10%, all non-emergency feature deployments freeze.

title: Circuit Breaker, Graceful Degradation & Chaos Engineering Runbook
text:
# Circuit Breaker, Graceful Degradation & Chaos Engineering Runbook

## Tri-State Circuit Breaker Mechanics
To prevent cascading timeouts when the upstream LLM provider degrades, the pipeline circuit breaker tracks rolling failures. After 10 consecutive upstream timeouts (CLOSED -> OPEN), the breaker stays OPEN for 15 seconds, automatically serving grounded extractive summaries directly from top-reranked chunks (`degraded_extractive_mode`) instead of returning HTTP 500 errors.

## Half-Open Recovery & Chaos Drills
After 15 seconds, the breaker transitions to HALF-OPEN and allows 3 probe requests. Monthly GameDay chaos drills inject 500 ms synthetic Qdrant jitter and kill 30% of gateway pods to verify 100% request completion within SLA error budgets.

title: Little's Law Capacity Planning for 10,000 Concurrent RAG Users
text:
# Little's Law Capacity Planning for 10,000 Concurrent RAG Users

## Mathematical Sizing Model
By Little's Law, `L = lambda * W`, where `L` is average concurrency, `lambda` is arrival rate (RPS), and `W` is average service latency in seconds.
- Suppose 10,000 concurrent users each trigger queries or wait in active request pipelines with average blended latency `W = 0.080s` (with 75% L1/L2 cache hits at 2 ms and 25% cold RAG at 310 ms): `lambda = 10,000 / 0.080 = 125,000 RPS` if all 10k are continuously in-flight, or for 10,000 simultaneous burst requests completing within 1.0 second, the cluster needs `>= 10,000 RPS` sustained capacity.

## Pod & Cache Sizing
Across 32 async FastAPI/Uvicorn workers (4 workers per 8-vCPU pod), each worker holds 256 async concurrency slots (`8,192` active cold slots + zero-block cache paths), comfortably absorbing 10,000 simultaneous requests without thread exhaustion.

title: Incident Severity Matrix (SEV-1 to SEV-4) & Postmortem Policy

# Incident Severity Matrix (SEV-1 to SEV-4) & Postmortem Policy

## Severity Classification
- **SEV-1 (Critical)**: >5% 5xx rate, cross-tenant data leakage (`ERR_SEC_TENANT_4039`), or complete outage of Tier-0 RAG APIs. 15-minute page response, executive bridge open.
- **SEV-2 (High)**: P99 latency > 2,000 ms for >10 minutes, cache cluster failover, or faithfulness score drop below 0.65.
- **SEV-3 (Medium)**: Single-shard degraded replication or non-critical ingestion lag > 30 min.

## Blameless Postmortem SLA
All SEV-1 and SEV-2 incidents require a blameless RCA document within 48 hours and golden regression test cases added to `data/eval/golden_qa.jsonl` within 5 business days.
